title: CEO (m/w/d) – Bandleader gesucht
description:
Ein Dirigent steht vor dem Orchester und gibt mit dem Taktstock den Ton an. Ein Bandleader steht mittendrin, spielt selbst mit, zählt ein – und hört genau hin, wann es Zeit für das Solo der anderen ist.
Genau diese Person suchen wir: jemanden, der unsere familiengeprägte Marketing- und Fundraising-Agentur in die nächste Generation führt. Mit Groove, mit Haltung und mit Freude am gemeinsamen Sound.
Die Band
Die asm Fundraising AG spielt seit mehr als 40 Jahren für Non-Profit-Organisationen, Stiftungen und öffentliche Institutionen – auf Bühnen in der ganzen Schweiz und in mehreren Sprachen. Unsere 20 Musikerinnen und Musiker beherrschen ganz unterschiedliche Instrumente: Strategie, Kreation, Daten und Fundraising.
Was uns zusammenhält, ist kein Notenblatt, sondern eine gemeinsame Haltung. Verlässlichkeit, Respekt und der Anspruch, der Sache zu dienen, sind der Grundton, auf dem alles aufbaut. Bei der Tourplanung ist der Verwaltungsrat mit an Bord: als Sparringpartner, der zuhört, mitdenkt und den gemeinsamen Sound mitprägt.
Ihre Rolle in der Band
Den Groove halten: Sie geben die strategische Richtung vor, denken voraus und entwickeln gemeinsam mit dem Verwaltungsrat das Repertoire unserer Agentur weiter.
Mitspielen statt dirigieren: Sie stehen mitten im Team, führen wertschätzend und umsetzungsstark und leben unsere Werte vor – aus Überzeugung, nicht aus Pflicht.
Soli ermöglichen: Sie erkennen Talente, fördern und coachen sie, delegieren gerne und verbinden einzelne Stimmen zu neuen Klängen.
Die Setlist zusammenstellen: Sie steuern das Kundenportfolio nach Wirtschaftlichkeit und Komplexität, gewinnen neue Mandate und erkennen, welche Stücke zusammenpassen.
Im Takt bleiben: Sie haben Zahlen, Kennzahlen und Controlling im Griff, setzen Vertragsmodelle flexibel ein und sorgen für Strukturen, die auch ohne Sie funktionieren.
Neue Stücke wagen: Sie hinterfragen Bestehendes, treiben die Digitalisierung voran und schaffen Raum für Improvisation – ohne den Schlussakkord aus den Augen zu verlieren.
Auf der Bühne stehen: Sie vertreten die Agentur glaubwürdig gegen aussen und bleiben ruhig, wenn mal eine Saite reisst.
Was Sie mitbringen
Ihr Instrumentenkoffer
Abschluss auf Tertiärstufe (FH oder Universität), idealerweise mit CAS oder MBA
Erfahrung als Geschäftsleiter/in oder GL-Mitglied
Fundraising-Verständnis und ein Netzwerk im NPO- und Philanthropie-Bereich
Betriebswirtschaftliche Sattelfestigkeit, Verhandlungsgeschick und Projektmanagement-Erfahrung
Digitale Urteilskraft, die den Menschen nicht aus dem Blick verliert – mit feinem Gehör für kritische Rückfragen und Feedback
Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel der föderalistischen Schweiz
Deutsch und Französisch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sehr gut; Italienisch ist Ihre Zugabe
Ihr Rhythmusgefühl
Sie fühlen sich in einem Familienunternehmen zu Hause und spielen gerne im Ensemble.
Sie sind integer, loyal und verlässlich – die Musik ist wichtiger als Ihr eigener Applaus.
Sie hören zu, bevor Sie spielen: mit hoher emotionaler Intelligenz und Gespür für Konstellationen.
Sie finden den richtigen Ton für jedes Publikum – von der Bundesrätin bis zur Reinigungskraft.
Sie machen Komplexes hörbar einfach und schaffen Klarheit, wenn es laut wird.
Sie sind neugierig, mutig und holen sich Rat, wenn ein Part neu ist.
Was wir Ihnen bieten
Ihr Platz auf der Bühne: die Mitte einer eingespielten, interdisziplinären Band
Ein Repertoire mit Sinn: Mandate für Organisationen, die Gesellschaft und Umwelt weiterbringen
Freiraum für neue Arrangements: viel Gestaltungsfreiheit und eine sorgfältige Übergabe – die ersten Stücke spielen wir gemeinsam
Ein Proberaum mit bester Akustik: zentraler Standort in Zürich und moderne Büroinfrastruktur
Pausen zwischen den Konzerten: 5 oder 6 Wochen Ferien, damit Sie mit frischer Energie zurück auf die Bühne kommen
Ein Sound, der nachklingt – auch nach der letzten Tour: attraktive Personenversicherungen, insbesondere eine starke berufliche Vorsorge, deren Beiträge mehrheitlich wir tragen
Lust auf eine Jam-Session?
Dann zählen Sie ein: Senden Sie uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Gerne stehen wir Ihnen auch für ein erstes Vorgespräch zur Verfügung. Diskretion ist selbstverständlich.

Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer at the Quantum Device Lab
description:
Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer at the Quantum Device Lab
At the Quantum Device Lab, led by Prof. Andreas Wallraff at the Department of Physics of ETH Zurich, we fabricate quantum devices using micro- and nanofabrication techniques. We use the devices to conduct state-of-the-art experimental research in quantum information science and technology. In particular, we work on scaling the developed technologies to build large-scale error-corrected quantum computers. We operate across various cleanrooms in the Zurich area, and develop new technology and approaches which benefit from a coherent, farsighted vision. We collaborate closely with academic and industrial partners within the quantum community.
Project background
We are looking for a Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer to join our interdisciplinary team doing research and development at the forefront of quantum technologies. You will play a crucial role in the development of quantum processor chips, working on devices that incorporate tens to hundreds of qubits. A primary goal of work will be the scaling of micro-fabricated chips, including the development of Through-Silicon-Vias (TSVs), connecting the front to back surface of the chips with high-quality superconducting films. These will reduce the impact of parasitic box modes, and enable alternative signal routing paths, enabling the scaling up in device size.
Job description
Your responsibilities will include:
Device fabrication: Execution and refinement of micro and nano-fabrication runs using existing fabrication processes.
Process development: Development and optimization of novel fabrication processes for scalable architectures (such as high-aspect-ratio TSVs deep reactive-ion etching and conformal coating).
Yield improvement: Systematic metrology inspection to continuously improve fabrication yield.
High-coherence compatibility: Collaboration with other fabrication engineers of the lab and the measurement researchers to evaluate impact of processes on qubit coherence metrics, and guarantee high-quality device outputs.
Documentation: Preparation of technical and scientific documentation of your work. Tracking of run logs and process metrics shared with scientists from the Quantum Device Lab who have the lead in characterizing and operating the fabricated devices.
Profile
We are looking for a highly motivated fabrication engineer to lead the fabrication and process development of devices that advance our capabilities in large-scale quantum computing.
Candidates must have experience in an academic and/or industrial setting in a number of the following areas:
Hands-on cleanroom experience: Proven record with semi- or superconductor processing techniques, such as electron beam lithography, photolithography, dry and wet etching, thin film deposition
Process control: surface characterization, metrology (optical-, scanning-electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy), material science, statistical process control, yield improvement, failure analysis.
Specialized equipment: practical technical knowledge of vacuum technology, (pumps, UHV systems, ...), leak detection, or cryogenic systems.
Research experience: ability to demonstrate high-quality reporting examples.
Further Requirements:
You are expected to be skilled in communicating your findings to collaborators in a multidisciplinary environment. You should have high attention to details, structured work habits, and the ability to handle complex workflows.
You must hold a Master degree or equivalent in micro- and nanofabrication, material science, physics, electrical engineering or a related field. A PhD degree can be helpful but is not required.
You must possess excellent English communication skills; knowledge of German is a plus.
We offer
In depth exposure the rapidly developing field of quantum technology, and opportunity to tackle a wide range of fabrication challenges, combined with ample learning opportunities.
A collaborative, interdisciplinary R&D environment. A rewarding, inspiring working environment with a flat hierarchy and open culture in a diverse and international team.
Access to state-of-the-art cleanroom fabrication facilities located at ETH Hönggerberg (FIRST), at IBM Rüschlikon (BRNC) and at PSI Villigen (PICO).
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich
We value diversity and sustainability
In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.
Curious? So are we.
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
A detailed curriculum vitae

Pdf copies of theses and transcripts/certificates from (under-)graduate studies (Bachelor, Master’s, and eventual PhD) and work certificates as available
Names of three contacts for references (Please arrange for one or more of the reference letters to be sent directly by email to wallraff.office@phys.ethz.ch)
Further information about the Quantum Device Lab can be found on our Website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to jbesse@phys.ethz.ch (no applications).
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices in Lugano (headquarter) and Zurich.

With the convergence of HPC and cloud technology, supercomputing service providers like CSCS strive to improve our service portfolios that focus on large, complex, and diverse scientific and engineering applications. Effectively providing performant and capable storage systems supporting the needs of HPC platforms running on a multi-tenant infrastructure is complex and challenging engineering work.
To support these efforts, CSCS is seeking a Storage Engineer (Systems Engineering) to join our team in Lugano. The position is initially offered on a two-year contract, with the possibility of extension. This position is funded by a project that will enable scientists to benefit from large scale climate and earth observation data, and will involve collaboration with partners such as the ETHZ Geolab and C2SM, as well as international partners such as ECMWF, NASA and NOAA.
Job description
The main goal of this position is to implement and operate HPC storage services in a multi-tenant infrastructure. As a Storage Engineer you will directly contribute to the designing, implementation, maintenance, and documentation of storage services for HPC.
Your contributions will directly impact the development and enhancement of HPC systems, thereby enhancing overall system functionality and efficiency.
Profile
You have a sound knowledge of
Linux administration skills
Generic filesystem aspects and functions (data, metadata, block-size etc.)
Storage redundancy technologies (RAID, D-RAID, EC etc.)
Backup solutions (DMF, TSM, Veeam) and backup concepts
Object Storage concepts and S3 service usage/implementation
Automation tools and framework, including CI/CD processes and ecosystem (e.g., Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)
Experience with the following is preferred, though there will be ample opportunities to learn and gain more experience with all of these skills on the job:
Experience with parallel file systems (GPFS, Lustre)
Experience with Ceph Storage Clusters
Experience with versioning systems and CI/CD workflows such as ArgoCD
Experience with physical servers automated installation systems such as OpenCHAMI, MAAS, or Foreman
Experience with developing Ansible configurations
Experience developing services on top of Kubernetes
You should have a bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst - all genders (80-100%)
description:
At Cembra, Financial Planning & Analytics plays a central role in turning financial and non-financial information into insight that supports better management decisions. We are looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst who combines strong finance expertise, analytical thinking and curiosity about modern analytics tools. The role goes beyond preparing reports: you will analyse performance drivers, challenge assumptions, improve forecasting transparency and help stakeholders understand the financial implications of business decisions.
As a Senior FP&A Analyst, you will work with financial and non-financial data, planning models, management reports and analytical applications. You will help convert complex data into clear, reliable and decision-relevant insights. You will also contribute to improving data models, ETL processes and the usability of analytical solutions, while collaborating with stakeholders across Finance, business functions and Technology.

Deliver clear, decision-oriented analysis of financial and non-financial performance, including variances, trends, risks and opportunities
Translate management questions into relevant KPIs, reports, dashboards and practical recommendations
Support month-end and year-end processes with accurate, timely and decision-relevant financial analysis
Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning, and maintain robust planning models and scenarios
Challenge assumptions constructively and assess the financial implications of business choices
Design and enhance reporting, planning applications, financial data models and data-transformation processes
Simplify, standardise and automate reporting and planning processes, partnering with Finance, business functions and Technology
Support colleagues in using management information and analytical tools effectively, and contribute to cross-functional analyses and projects.

Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline
At least five years of relevant experience in management accounting, financial reporting, planning or FP&A
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting standards, including US GAAP or IFRS
Hands-on experience with BI and analytics tools such as Qlik Sense or Power BI, including data modelling and ETL processes
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query and Power Pivot; experience with ERP and general ledger systems is an advantage
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights
Clear communication and presentation skills in English; German is an advantage
Proactive, independent and improvement-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

The opportunity to help shape the further development of Cembra, Finance and modern FP&A.

title: Product Owner – B2B Digital Ecosystem Platform at ETH Space
description:
Product Owner – B2B Digital Ecosystem Platform at ETH Space
ETH Zurich | Space’s mission is to boost space activities to establish ETH Zurich as the leading university in space research and Earth observation, education and entrepreneurship within Europe and beyond. ETH Zurich | Space encompasses overall five units: Education, Research, Entrepreneurship, the ETH Swiss GeoLab, and the space mission LIFE.
Please apply until 31.10.2026
Project background
In support of our initiatives within the Entrepreneurship unit of ETH Zurich | Space, we are spearheading the creation of a highly secure, closed B2B digital platform in collaboration with ESA and their ESA Commercialization network. The ultimate objective of this ecosystem platform is to give the European space startup and industry ecosystem a boost, by facilitating more cross-border connections, commercial deals, and collaboration across Europe, to accelerate companies’ development overall.
The platform is designed to connect international institutional stakeholders, space and related industry partners, startup founders (e.g. from ESA Business Incubation Centers across Europe), and other important players. The platform will integrate data-driven insights and advanced matching capabilities (including via AI).
We are seeking a structured and driven Product Owner to take this initiative from its initial concept phase through finalized specification, vendor selection, and full-scale implementation. Rapid prototyping, beta testing and continuous learning are considered key in the development process.
Job description
In this role, you will serve as the strategic bridge between a diverse network of high-profile international stakeholders (e.g. from ESA, space companies, ESA BIC managers), agile entrepreneurs (e.g. from the ESA BIC network), and software engineers. You will lead the requirements engineering process, translate ecosystem needs into clear technical specifications, select the right development partner, and take ultimate ownership of the project's timely delivery.
Key responsibilities include:
Lead stakeholder scoping workshops: plan and facilitate targeted requirement workshops with diverse user groups – ranging from institutional managers and corporate partners to startup founders – to align expectations and unify the product vision.
Finalize product specifications: evolve the current draft concept into a comprehensive, production-ready product specification package and structured backlog.
Vendor & partner management: lead the technical evaluation and onboarding process for the external software development partner.
Roadmap ownership: manage the overarching project timeline, ensuring key milestones are met for a timely, high-quality deployment.
Oversee development & quality: supervise the external implementation partner throughout the development, testing, and deployment cycles, ensuring rigorous adherence to timelines and scope.
Ensure technical & security excellence: Define and enforce robust platform governance, including strict role-based access management, secure third-party data integrations, high-standard data residency compliance, and system scalability.
Stakeholder management: beyond the scoping workshops, you are the principal person to interact with diverse stakeholders, to integrate their different perspectives, and to make sure that the project stays on track and delivers the promised results.
Profile
Education: a university degree in computer science or a related field is expected. We are open to other degrees if you have significant, relevant work experience.
Experience: you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience with a proven track record as a Product Owner or Product Manager leading the delivery of complex web-based B2B portals, collaboration networks, or enterprise-grade software applications.
Technical skills:
Strong technical literacy: sound understanding of modern web application frameworks, API / webhook architecture, role-based access control, and modern AI / LLM deployment frameworks.
Data & AI savviness: experience defining requirements for smart matching engines, data-processing pipelines, or AI-driven user feeds is highly advantageous
Competencies & personality:
Stakeholder management: exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to navigate and build consensus within academic, (inter-) governmental (like ESA), corporate and startup environments.
Vendor management expertise: practical experience in coordinating external software development vendor, supervising agile sprints, and overseeing quality assurance/testing phases.
Independent approach and strong organizational skills
Proactive and reliable personality
Solution-oriented and service-oriented working style
Enjoy working with complex project structures
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build bridges across teams and cultures
Language proficiency: full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required, German is a plus.
We offer
A high-impact management role at a world-class institution, directly driving innovation within the rapidly expanding space technology ecosystem.
A vibrant, intellectually stimulating work environment at ETH Zurich I Space based in Zurich.
The opportunity to shape a long-term digital, cross-European infrastructure project from its foundational stages.
A workplace in downtown Zurich.
Fixed-term contract for 3 years (possibly with option to extend).
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich
We value diversity and sustainability
In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.
Curious? So are we.

Your CV
